definition: A defined version or set of service or product components made available for use as a unit.
rationale: Use this noun for the version or set of service or product components that is made available for use as a unit. It is not the release-management practice or activity, a deployment, a change, a change authority, a target environment, an artifact, a version number without its contents, or an availability result. Keep this noun separate from the ASD RELEASE verb, which has the source meaning to make free or let go.

allowed.text: The release contains the approved service components for the next production deployment.
allowed.rationale: Names the version or component set and keeps it distinct from the later deployment activity.

not_allowed.text: Release the application to free the database lock.
not_allowed.rationale: Uses the ASD-derived release verb meaning to make free rather than the IT service-management noun.

criteria: Verify that the noun names a defined version or set of service or product components made available for use as a unit.

Keep the noun distinct from the release-management practice or activity, deployment, change, change authority, target environment, artifact, version number, availability result, and the ASD RELEASE verb.
